Exp7 Platform shell 1.2.0 · lean candidate


About the key and this test

Fine-grained key for your own account, only your own public test repo, Contents read/write. Kept only in this tab's memory; never stored, logged or reported. Nothing is written until you press a write button. Everything written is tiny synthetic data and stays in public history — never type personal information.

Platform shell 1.2.0 (lean candidate, not production). Key only for publishing to your personal data repo; the workspace works offline.

Workspace (shared data)

What is saved and shared here: a small workspace (Title, Status, Items). It is saved in this browser first (works offline) and shared only when you press Publish, as small public JSON files in your own repo under exp7-platform-v1/. The Exp7 planner's own internal state is not saved or shared by the platform yet.

Updates (local package import, explicit trial)

Software source/release repo: configured in the launcher only (read-only, separate repo; this page never writes to it). Personal data repo: the one above; updates never write or replace personal data.

No hosted release channel yet. An update is an .html package you choose, optionally with an exp7-release/1 manifest. It runs sandboxed (no access to your keys or platform data), starts as a TRIAL, and the previous version is kept. If you close the page without pressing Keep, the previous version comes back.




Platform test

  1. Offline: paste key once (so the account is saved), Create workspace. Turn Wi-Fi off, tick the box, save 2 edits. Quit (Cmd+Q), reopen, press Open offline: …, tick the second box — edits still listed.
  2. Sync: Wi-Fi on, paste key, Publish, then Public check.
  3. Two accounts (optional): second window, other account's key; exchange join info, each saves an item and a different Title, Publish, Refresh, exchange results, Compare.
  4. Updates: press Open app; in Updates press Run bad-update drill, then Activate as trial, then Revert. The Exp7 app should be back.
  5. Press Copy results and send it.
